digest.component_or_area: GitHub Actions mirror CI trigger policy and main-health reporting
propositions: Cancelled GitHub Actions runs on main render as red X on healthy commits, misleading the mirror status.
Push-triggered CI for main must be replaced with scheduled runs (every 6 hours) to avoid cancellation-driven false reds.
Non-main branch push CI must be preserved; main is added to branches-ignore for four workflows while codeql and terraform-drift drop push entirely.
Last-known-green SHA and git bisect recipe must be published to workflow summary to enable rapid post-incident bisection without per-commit visibility.
All six changed workflows gain workflow_dispatch for on-demand health checks; three gain 6-hourly crons, security and infrastructure workflows keep their original cadences.
External-integration and reconciler workflows are excluded from this change; gerrit-verify remains unmodified to preserve pre-merge gating parity.
